title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
supporting_stats: Offensive Rebound: 60.0% on 20 attempts; P&R Ball Handler: 56.5% on 23 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points above their 45.9% overall clip on 15+ attempts. Offensive Rebound: hit a body on every shot before going to the ball. P&R Ball Handler: pick one ball-screen coverage and stay in it -- keep the handler out of the middle.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
recommendation: Each is 5+ points below their 45.9% overall clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure the actions they turn it over on
supporting_stats: Post-Up: 9 TO in 28 uses (32.1% vs 11.3% across all actions); P&R Ball Handler: 4 TO in 27 uses (14.8% vs 11.3% across all actions)
recommendation: Loosest actions per use, not the most common ones -- load ball pressure and gap help onto these specifically rather than pressing everything.
